newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Norilsk mayor detained on bribery charges.
newsitem.headline: Russia Norilsk mayor detained on bribery charges.

text.p: The mayor of Russia's Siberian city of Norilsk, home to the world's biggest nickel plant Norilsk Nickel, has been detained for alleged bribe-taking, Interfax news agency said on Monday.

The agency said prosecutors in the city of Chernogorsk in the neighbouring region of Khakassia detained Vasily Tkachev in a bribery case linked to a local construction firm and held him in custody in Chernogorsk.
Norilsk Nickel is one of the world's largest producers of nickel and has major reserves of platinum group metals.
